questions.question: Paul sent Tychicus to the Colossians. What was Tychicus going to tell them?
Epaphras was always wrestling in prayer for the Colossians. What did he pray for them?

answers.text: To stand mature in God's will
To stay safe from all trouble

questions.question: After the Colossians read Paul's letter to them, what did Paul want done with it?

answers.text: Have it read in another church
Keep it safe with the elders

questions.question: Paul ended his letter to the Colossians by asking them to remember his chains. True or false?
